newsitem.title: PANAMA: K.C. Southern Panama rail pact seen final by June.
newsitem.headline: K.C. Southern Panama rail pact seen final by June.

text.p: Panama is likely to finalize an exclusive concession with Kansas City Southern Industries Inc to operate Panama Railroad Co by June, a top government official said Friday.
"Contract negotiations are advancing rapidly and it should be signed by the Cabinet by mid-May," National Port Authority Director Hugo Torrijos said.
Final approval is expected from Congress in June.

Torrijos told foreign correspondents that Kansas City Southern will rehabilitate the railroad, creating a 47.6-mile (76 km) link between the Atlantic and Pacific oceans that should be operational in two years.
